subject: Civic Education
competence: Internalizes the qualities of a good labourer
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the good qualities of a worker.
Expresses the importance of maintaining good qualities in the work place.
the_entrance: Introduction to the importance of good qualities in the workplace

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of good qualities in the workplace
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Take notes on the importance of good qualities

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on good qualities
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and share examples
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and provide feedback

summary: Recap the importance of good qualities in the workplace
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check on understanding good qualities
post_activity: Complete a worksheet on good qualities in the workplace
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Good Qualities in the Workplace Worksheet
